notes.title: Small bug update
notes.notes: Fixed bug on new game start.

notes.title: Version rc0.3.7
notes.notes:
Fixed bullet rotation for player and Turret
Fixed bug where every time a game was loaded the player was told they have new emails even when they don’t
Added teleportation to the dock
Fixed save file bug when exiting the game

notes.title: Version rc0.3.6
notes.notes:
Added additional emails to guide the player along
Fixed bug where progress emails weren’t being saved
Changed mouse shooting to support multiple angles
Changed develop and defend mouse cursors
Fixed bug where Hover audio played when going back to main menu

notes.title: Version rc0.3.5
notes.notes:
Fixed static variables for player health, fuel
Adjusted fuel rate to be half as much
Moved all start emails to the “Deleted” folder.  Saved games will look weird because you'll have duplicate emails in Inbox and Deleted, but new games should be good.
Adjust R-01 friction rate so it’s smoother when sliding across.

notes.title: Develop bugfix
notes.notes: Fixed bug where game would crash when placing object down

notes.title: Version rc0.3.2
notes.notes:
Added Parasite
.. also, sorry about the full screen of the last build.  Forgot to click a checkbox >:X

notes.title: Version rc0.3
notes.notes:
Fixed bug where exiting a game back to main menu, and then starting a new game, is keeping static variables set to the last game instead of resetting them
Update tutorial, highlight upper select boxes, more interactivity
Fixed bug where full screen is enabled/disabled when entering player name, full screen toggle moved to pause menu
Added ability to press enter on callsign entry

notes.title: Version rc0.2
notes.notes:
- Updated help image
- Inventory Help Arrows now look a lot better
- Adding labels showing what the item you're crafting is
- Fixed bug where michael's develop mode minibulb took the object without being able to place it (items now drop if they can't be built)
- Email when you die
- Bug where you can put fuel block down and constantly get fuel (added Spent Fuel)
- Better new email alert
- Removed R-01 entrance computer
- AIR/HEAT indicators are less pronounced
